days.proposal_contribution: TWO GENERAL-RULE PROPOSALS (text only, no brain edit). PROPOSAL 1 - extend flow.resting_program_inverts_aggressor_tilt to the futures-expiry roll (n=2 spanning groups). The play's own mechanism text already generalizes ('a property of ANY resting program') but its trigger names only in_bcom_roll / in_gsci_roll - it can never fire on the largest scheduled program in the NG calendar, the roll out of the expiring prompt on LTD. Add trigger arm: is_expiry_day TRUE (days_to_futures_expiry == 0) AND the measured leg is the roll DESTINATION (calendar_next of the expiring front). Two forms, one physics: index-roll form (G21 0608, front leg) - the program RESTS and the aggressor tilt is the crowd, INVERTED vs the program; expiry form (G22 0626, deferred leg) - the deadline program AGGRESSES and the tilt is SATURATED by mechanics (210 big prints 0.783 size-weighted vs 122 at 0.499 on the 0625 scheduled-flow control; breadth unmoved 0.509->0.504; session flow FELL +1,956->+871 while the cohort alone bought >= ~+4,800 net, residual tape net seller; final phase 64% of volume with NEGATIVE price conviction, -410 under +2,737). In both forms the aggressor tilt carries no sentiment; read the RESIDUAL (session net minus big-print cohort net) and the two-sided breadth series. CONSEQUENCE SCOPE-GUARD: on trigger days, ALL big-print-share instruments lose authority - flow.price_free_absorption_proxy, the 0.547 flip bar, and any handoff confirm/refute limb built on them (my own refute-limb-2 fired on the letter and was void on the mechanism; a Friday owner's confirm/refute conditions must carry a program-day exemption clause). FALSIFIER: an expiry day where the deferred-leg big-print cohort matches the residual tape's sign and the day delivers that sign. PROPOSAL 2 - burn-residual constraint limb + slope-not-gap grammar (operationalizing the adjudicated S109 weather doctrine; honest scoping stated). (a) Any summer weather flip/confirm condition must be keyed on BURN, not gross CDD: grid_stack est_gas_burn_bcfd + wind_mwh trend (served in every slice at 2-day lag, decision-time-legit) - CDD is gross power demand, wind/solar serve it first, gas is the residual. The constraint limb is the summer analog of winter freeze-off in the anomaly x duration x CONSTRAINT multiplier. Measured, both constraint states inside g22: wind-on (period 06-27: wind +62%, burn -4.2 Bcf/d) suppressed a +4.8 gw_cdd hill and Monday ran -1,160 against a CDD-keyed flip UP; wind-off (06-29..07-01: wind 2.14M->1.69M, burn 34.4->44.8) let the SAME hill deliver +780/+410. Within-block n=2 (two states) - proposed as MECHANISM WITH STATED PRECONDITION, forward test = the next CDD block carrying a wind event; the S109 audit had already named grid_stack the served-but-unread channel. (b) magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery branch adjudication: FRESH means NOT IN THE D-1 LADDER - a hill visible at the Friday close takes the PRICED branch (+200..+400) regardless of how much it grows, because a forecast-visible hill prices as a SLOPE through the sessions (a hill slopes, it does not gap). Cross-group n>=2 for this grammar: the play's own priced instances (1124 ~+250, 0111) plus G22 0629 (+50 gap on a visible hill, with the -1,160 delivered INSIDE the session); its fresh instances (1019/0118/0125) were all winter shots the market first saw in the weekend cycles. CROSS-CUTTING NOTE (one failure class, two instances, this block): a served channel read at its GROSS level when the tradeable quantity is the RESIDUAL - aggressor flow gross vs ex-program residual (proposal 1), CDD gross demand vs gas-burn residual (proposal 2). The audit class 'served-but-unread' should gain the sibling 'read-at-the-wrong-level'.
